audience: admin Insights and stage dashboard (aggregate only)

definitions.joinedRate: participants with a session / null (no denominator in v1)
definitions.completedRate: boards READY or LOCKED_ACTIVE or FINISHED-with-25 / joined participants
definitions.activeRate: LOCKED_ACTIVE boards / joined participants (current or last round)
definitions.topSkills: count of boards (READY+) containing the skill, descending, top 10
definitions.coreCriticalDensity: selections split by skill.isCore / skill.isCritical / neither across READY+ boards
definitions.matrixAlignmentRate: mean over participants of inMatrixCount/25 using each participant's role map at matrixVersion
definitions.skillsBeyondMatrix: skills selected that are not in the participant's role map, aggregated, top 10
definitions.cohortSuppression: Platform/Role breakdowns are omitted when the cohort has fewer than 5 joined participants (D-15)
